article: Salesforce開発向けChrome拡張2選：機能と導入前の確認点
scope: Compared the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations: descriptions, features, terminology, data and permission disclosures, privacy policy, dated listing metadata, descriptions, and links. Mathematical formulas and executable code are not present.
findings: Removed a duplicate future publication date and retained publication date 2022-05-02; set lastmod to 2026-11-24.
Reframed the recommendations as a dated snapshot because extension features, permissions, and store metadata can change.
Added the DevTools listing disclosure for Location and Web history and its displayed version/update date.
Added the Code Searcher developer policy statement that the Salesforce instance URL and access/refresh tokens are stored in browser local storage for API calls.
Added a caution to inspect current permissions/privacy disclosures and obtain organization administrator approval before connecting a work Salesforce org.

post/SalesforceおすすめChrome拡張/index.en.md.summary: Compared the full Japanese article and twelve translations with current Chrome Web Store listings and the Code Searcher developer privacy policy; corrected factual scope, data-handling disclosures, dates, and work-org cautions.

meaning.note: Compared full descriptions, supported development tasks, third-party status, listing dates, and installation cautions across the Japanese source and all translations.

terminology.note: Checked product names, SOQL, Apex, Visualforce, Salesforce REST API, OAuth, access/refresh tokens, browser local storage, Location, and Web history disclosures.

mathematics.note: No formulas or calculations are present; versions and dates were checked as listing metadata.

code.note: No executable code or commands are included; feature descriptions were compared with the cited store listings.

links.note: Checked both Chrome Web Store product pages and the Code Searcher developer privacy policy, which says the Salesforce instance URL and access/refresh tokens are kept in browser local storage for API calls.

limitations: AI-assisted review; no human or native-speaker certification.
Extension use, permissions, functionality, and vendor disclosures were not tested in a live Salesforce org; listings and policies may change after the review date.
The vendor privacy policy is a provider statement and was not independently audited.
